Treating the development dependency as the shipped binary

graphEvents.label: What mistakes did the plugin precedent already pay for
Build parity refusals and shipped-payload gaps

label: Claude Code supplies no Node for a bundle and does not expand bundle folder settings, so plugin.json must run node and the README must document Node as external; the Node 18 claim was superseded by the 20.9.0 engines floor.

The plugin build resolves linked rule files into real files and fails on any copied file that differs from source or any link in the unpacked server; Product Owner already replaced four shared rule symlinks with copies for the standalone-clone reason.

A rule treating any download redirect as failure made installs impossible on eight of ten pinned platform URLs, and it was amended to allow exactly one host-checked redirect; a protective rule can silently cut platform coverage.

Tests resolved a development binary while the shipped plugin carried a different pinned build, and the shipped-payload run produced 45 capability-unrelated failures; shipped parity needs its own test pass.

A skill rename propagated into the plugin copy path, the Project knowledge names and the rebuild and re-upload steps in one release, with whole-folder replacement so an old-name copy cannot ship beside the new one.

Bundled-tool behavior differences become operator decisions rather than test outcomes, as when a shipped ffmpeg changed how it copies audio into MP4 and the phase recorded the trade-off for the operator.
